# Consumables

Eat / drink / quaff to restore. Brand-new characters start with a few.

| Item | Restores |
|---|---|
| Crusty Bread | +40 endurance |
| Healing Potion | +50 HP, +15 endurance |
| Raw Chicken | +20 endurance |
| Stamina Draught | +75 endurance |
